# Polenta — Task Outline

## Template

- **Name:** Polenta
- **Source:** ColorLib "Risotto" — https://colorlib.com/wp/template/risotto/
- **Preview:** https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/risotto/
- **Category:** Restaurant

## Design Tokens

- Brand: #f36700 (orange)
- Body: #969696, Headings: #151515
- Fonts: Quicksand (headings), Cabin (body), Dancing Script (section titles)
- Buttons: rounded (40px radius), orange bg, white text

## Sections

1. Navbar (two-tier: logo+social, nav+reserve+contact)
2. Hero (parallax bg, welcome text, CTA)
3. About (lead text, paragraph, gallery carousel)
4. Menu (tabbed: Dinner/Drinks/Lunch/Dessert, dish grid)
5. Reservation (form + opening times)
6. Events (4 cards, 2-col grid)
7. Contact (info + social + map placeholder)
8. Footer (copyright + Component Dock + nav)
